name: Omachill
author: Ronny Iversen
description: Float every window on the current workspace in place, with glass and soft corners; press again to tile them back exactly where they were.

barWidget.description: Shows when the active workspace is chilled; click to toggle.

schema.label: Toggle key
schema.description: Hyprland bind string for toggling chill mode on the current workspace (empty = no key). Omarchy's Calendar webapp sits on the default; it is unbound while this plugin is enabled.

schema.label: Hide key
schema.description: Hyprland bind string that parks the focused window on its monitor's hidden pile, keeping its size and place (empty = no key). macOS Cmd+H.

schema.label: Restore key
schema.description: Brings the most recently hidden window back onto the workspace you are looking at, tiled or floated exactly where it was (empty = no key).

schema.label: Inset (%)
schema.description: Each chilled window pulls in by this much of its own size on every side. 10 keeps 80% of width and height.

schema.label: Newcomer size (%)
schema.description: Size of a window arriving on a chilled workspace that has nothing to copy from, as a percentage of the work area.

schema.label: Notify on toggle
schema.description: Show a desktop notification when a workspace is chilled or tiled back.

schema.label: Hide widget when nothing is chilled
schema.description: Only show the bar icon while the active workspace is chilled.
